E01-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E01-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E01-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E01-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E02-CAS: SELECT iata_code, icao_code FROM airports WHERE night_curfew = 1
E02-SCH: SELECT iata_code FROM airports WHERE night_curfew = 1 ORDER BY iata_code
E02-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT airports.iata_code, airports.icao_code FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE airports.night_curfew = 1
E02-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT a.name AS airport_name FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id WHERE a.night_curfew = 1 AND ca.is_pilot_flying = 1
E03-CAS: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink'
E03-SCH: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY name
E03-BIZ: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink'
E03-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name, c.country, c.city FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN insurance_claims i ON s.shipment_id = i.shipment_id JOIN airlines a ON a.home_hub_airport_id = s.origin_airport_id WHERE a.alliance = 'CargoLink'
E04-CAS: SELECT model FROM aircraft_types WHERE manufacturer = 'Airbus'
E04-SCH: SELECT model FROM aircraft_types WHERE manufacturer = 'Airbus'
E04-BIZ: SELECT aircraft_types.model, aircraft_types.engine_count, aircraft_types.wingspan_m, aircraft_types.max_range_km, aircraft_types.cruise_speed_kmh FROM aircraft_types JOIN aircraft ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft_types.manufacturer = 'Airbus'
E04-VAG: SELECT model, engine_model, engine_count, wingspan_m FROM aircraft_types WHERE manufacturer = 'Airbus'
E05-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'
E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'
E05-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'
E05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'
E06-CAS: SELECT aircraft_id, status FROM aircraft WHERE status != 'active'
E06-SCH: SELECT tail_number, status FROM aircraft WHERE status != 'active'
E06-BIZ: SELECT aircraft.serial_number, aircraft.status FROM aircraft WHERE aircraft.status IN ('maintenance', 'retired')
E06-VAG: SELECT aircraft_id, tail_number, airline_id, year_manufactured, status, delivery_date, engine_count, wingspan_m, max_range_km, cruise_speed_kmh, fuel_capacity_kg FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE status = 'out'
E07-CAS: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier
E07-SCH: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier
E07-BIZ: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(customer_id) AS headcount FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier
E07-VAG: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier
E08-CAS: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany'
E08-SCH: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany'
E08-BIZ: SELECT c.account_code, c.city FROM customers c WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
E08-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name, c.country, c.customer_type, c.is_known_shipper, c.sales_region, c.created_date FROM customers c WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
E09-CAS: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E09-SCH: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(*) FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E09-BIZ: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E09-VAG: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E10-CAS: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) AS total_floor_space_m2 FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'
E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'
E10-BIZ: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) AS total_cold_chain_footprint FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'
E10-VAG: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) AS total_cold_chain_space FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'
M01-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS plane_count FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT a.name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS aircraft_count FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC, a.name
M01-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS fleet_size FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, COUNT(ac.aircraft_id) AS aircraft_count, AVG(ac.year_manufactured) AS avg_year_manufactured, AVG(ac.total_flight_hours) AS avg_total_flight_hours FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id GROUP BY a.name
M02-CAS: SELECT a.type_id, at.model, COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY a.type_id, at.model
M02-SCH: SELECT t.type_id, t.model, COUNT(*) AS active_aircraft_count FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types t ON a.type_id = t.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY t.type_id, t.model ORDER BY t.model
M02-BIZ: SELECT aircraft_types.icao_type_designator, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS active_fleet_count FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft.status = 'active' GROUP BY aircraft_types.icao_type_designator
M02-VAG: SELECT at.type_id, at.model, COUNT(*) AS active_planes FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY at.type_id, at.model
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id IN (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST') AND status = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(s.total_volume_m3) AS completed_departure_volume FROM flights f JOIN shipments s ON f.flight_id = s.flight_id JOIN airports a ON f.origin_airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE a.iata_code = 'IST' AND f.status = 'completed'
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) AS busy_level FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST'
M04-CAS: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT a1.iata_code AS origin_iata, a2.iata_code AS destination_iata, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM flights f JOIN airports a1 ON f.origin_airport_id = a1.airport_id JOIN airports a2 ON f.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a1.iata_code, a2.iata_code ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT T1.lane_number, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM lanes AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.lane_number = T2.departure_lane WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.lane_number ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM flights GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY route_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(T1.delay_minutes) AS average_delay_minutes FROM incidents AS T1 INNER JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.flight_cargo_id = T2.flight_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T1.incident_type = 'delay'
M05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, ROUND(AVG((julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_arrival)) * 1440), 1) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flights JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(incidents.delay_minutes) AS average_delay, airlines.name AS carrier_name FROM incidents JOIN flights ON incidents.flight_cargo_id = flights.flight_id JOIN airlines ON flights.airline_id = airlines.airline_id WHERE incidents.incident_type = 'delay' GROUP BY airlines.name
M05-VAG: SELECT name FROM airlines ORDER BY founded_year DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M06-SCH: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, SUM(s.total_volume_m3) AS cancellation_volume FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id JOIN shipments s ON f.shipment_id = s.shipment_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M06-VAG: SELECT a.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS cancellation_count FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY a.name
M07-CAS: SELECT a.iata_code, SUM(f.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_co2_emissions_tonnes FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id GROUP BY a.iata_code
M07-SCH: SELECT SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg / 1000) AS avg_co2_emissions_per_1000, airlines.name FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN flights ON fuel_uplifts.flight_id = flights.flight_id JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id JOIN airlines ON aircraft.airline_id = airlines.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ROUND(SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg / 1000), 1)
M07-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS carrier_name, SUM(f.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_co2_emissions_tonnes FROM airlines a JOIN fuel_uplifts f ON a.home_hub_airport_id = f.airport_id GROUP BY a.name
M07-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, SUM(fu.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_emissions_kg FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id JOIN fuel_uplifts fu ON f.flight_id = fu.flight_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY total_emissions_kg DESC
M08-CAS: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre, airports.region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_price_per_litre, airports.region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region ROUND(avg_price_per_litre, 4)
M08-BIZ: SELECT a.region, AVG(f.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre FROM fuel_uplifts f JOIN airports a ON f.airport_id = a.airport_id GROUP BY a.region
M08-VAG: SELECT airport_id, AVG(price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_price_per_litre FROM fuel_uplifts GROUP BY airport_id ORDER BY avg_price_per_litre DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT a.iata_code, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.iata_code HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT a.name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.name HAVING warehouse_count >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT a.name, a.airport_id, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT a.name, a.airport_id, a.is_cargo_hub, a.night_curfew, a.region, a.runway_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT a.iata_code, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.iata_code HAVING bonded_warehouse_count > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT a.name, a.airport_id FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.name, a.airport_id HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT a.name, a.airport_id, a.is_cargo_hub, a.night_curfew, a.region, a.runway_count, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.airline_id ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT a.tail_number, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY flight_count DESC, a.tail_number ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, a.iata_code AS airline_code, ac.serial_number AS aircraft_serial_number, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.airline_id, ac.serial_number ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, at.model AS plane_model, SUM(f.quantity_kg) AS total_cargo FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN aircraft_types at ON ac.type_id = at.type_id JOIN fuel_uplifts f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name, at.model ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, al.name AS airline_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS landing_count FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.destination_airport_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id JOIN crew_members cm ON ca.crew_member_id = cm.crew_member_id JOIN airlines al ON cm.airline_id = al.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND ca.assignment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, al.name ORDER BY landing_count DESC
H02-SCH: SELECT d.iata_code, d.name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM ( SELECT f.destination_airport_id, a.iata_code, a.name FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON f.destination_airport_id = a.home_hub_airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY f.destination_airport_id, a.iata_code, a.name ORDER BY COUNT(f.flight_id) DESC, a.name LIMIT 1 ) d GROUP BY d.iata_code, d.name
H02-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, a.iata_code AS airline_code, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM airlines a JOIN flights f ON a.home_hub_airport_id = f.destination_airport_id AND f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, a.iata_code ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, a.country AS country, a.alliance AS alliance, a.icao_code AS icao_code, ap.name AS airport_name, ap.country AS airport_country, ap.region AS region, ap.runway_count AS runway_count, ap.is_cargo_hub AS is_cargo_hub, ap.night_curfew AS night_curfew, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.capacity_tonnes AS capacity_tonnes, w.cold_room_count AS cold_room_count, w.dock_door_count AS dock_door_count, w.opened_year AS opened_year FROM airlines a JOIN airports ap ON a.home_hub_airport_id = ap.airport_id JOIN warehouses w ON ap.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE a.is_cargo_only = 1 ORDER BY a.founded_year DESC, a.total_flight_hours DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date)) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_amount, SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date)) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(COALESCE(insurance_claims.approved_amount_usd, 0)) AS insurance_claims, SUM(COALESCE(maintenance_records.parts_cost_usd, 0) + COALESCE(maintenance_records.labor_cost_usd, 0)) AS maintenance_costs, SUM(COALESCE(payments.amount_usd, 0)) AS payments_received FROM invoices LEFT JOIN insurance_claims ON invoices.shipment_id = insurance_claims.shipment_id LEFT JOIN maintenance_records ON invoices.shipment_id = maintenance_records.shipment_id LEFT JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2023'
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights, SUM(f.total_cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd, LAG(COUNT(f.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.actual_departure)) - COUNT(f.flight_id) AS change_in_flights, LAG(SUM(f.total_cost_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.actual_departure)) - SUM(f.total_cost_usd) AS change_in_cost FROM flights f WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.actual_departure) ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(flights.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure)) - COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS difference FROM flights WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) ORDER BY month
H04-BIZ: SELECT DATE(actual_departure, 'localtime') AS month, SUM(total_volume_m3) AS total_volume_m3, LAG(SUM(total_volume_m3)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(actual_departure, 'localtime')) AS previous_month_volume FROM flights JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id JOIN shipments ON flight_cargo.shipment_id = shipments.shipment_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS flight_count, AVG(flights.distance_km) AS avg_distance_km, AVG(fuel_uplifts.fuel_burned_kg) AS avg_fuel_burned_kg, AVG(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS avg_co2_emissions_kg FROM flights LEFT JOIN fuel_uplifts ON flights.flight_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f.actual_arrival) - julianday(f.actual_departure)) AS avg_ground_time FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT a.tail_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_departure) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) AS avg_time_diff FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed' JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.actual_departure > f1.actual_arrival GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT a.serial_number, AVG(julianday(f2.actual_arrival) - julianday(f1.actual_departure)) AS avg_turnaround FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id AND f1.status = 'completed' JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f2.flight_id > f1.flight_id GROUP BY a.serial_number ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT meta_value FROM benchmark_meta WHERE meta_key = 'as_of_timestamp'
H06-CAS: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(i.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-SCH: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS ratio FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices i ON s.shipment_id = i.shipment_id JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.original_currency = 'USD' GROUP BY c.name HAVING ratio > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT c.account_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, (SUM(i.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.account_code HAVING revenue > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-VAG: SELECT c.account_code, c.name, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT a.name, SUM(s.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_cargo_tonnes FROM airports a JOIN shipments s ON a.airport_id = s.origin_airport_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY total_cargo_tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT a.name AS origin_airport, SUM(s.total_weight_kg / 1000) AS total_tonnes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.total_weight_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id JOIN shipments s ON fc.shipment_id = s.shipment_id WHERE fc.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, SUM(t.weight_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN tracking_events t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id AND t.event_code = 'DEP' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT a.name, a.airport_id, a.is_cargo_hub, a.night_curfew, a.region, a.runway_count, w.cold_room_count, w.capacity_tonnes, w.dock_door_count, w.opened_year FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id JOIN customs_declarations cd ON w.warehouse_id = cd.warehouse_id WHERE cd.declaration_type = 'export' ORDER BY w.capacity_tonnes DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT at.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM aircraft_types at JOIN aircraft a ON at.type_id = a.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND f.actual_departure IS NOT NULL AND f.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL AND f.takeoff_weight_kg > 0 AND f.distance_km > 0 AND f.quantity_kg > 0 AND f.quantity_kg * at.max_volume_m3 / 2 < f.quantity_kg GROUP BY at.model
H08-SCH: SELECT a.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM aircraft_types a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.type_id = ac.type_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND fc.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY a.model HAVING SUM(fc.total_volume_m3) > 0.5 * a.max_volume_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT at.icao_type_designator, COUNT(fc.flight_id) AS completed_flights_exceeding_50_vlf FROM aircraft_types at JOIN aircraft a ON at.type_id = a.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND fc.leg_status = 'flown' AND (fc.uld_type = 'PAG' OR fc.uld_type = 'RKN') AND (fc.position_code LIKE 'A%' OR fc.position_code LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY at.icao_type_designator HAVING SUM(fc.max_volume_m3 * fc.quantity_kg / (at.max_volume_m3 * at.max_payload_kg)) > 0.5 * COUNT(fc.flight_id)
H08-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT a.model FROM aircraft_types a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.type_id = ac.type_id WHERE ac.total_flight_hours BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(total_flight_hours) FROM aircraft) AND (SELECT AVG(total_flight_hours) FROM aircraft)
H09-CAS: SELECT a1.name AS airline_name, a1.founded_year, a1.callsign FROM airlines a1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM airports ah WHERE ah.is_cargo_hub = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aircraft ac JOIN shipments s ON ac.home_airport_id = s.destination_airport_id WHERE ac.airline_id = a1.airline_id AND s.status = 'delivered' ) )
H09-SCH: SELECT T1.tail_number FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.destination_airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT a.serial_number FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id JOIN maintenance_records mr ON a.aircraft_id = mr.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND ca.assignment_status = 'completed' AND mr.status = 'completed'
H09-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT a.tail_number, a.year_manufactured, a.status, a.delivery_date, at.model, at.engine_count, at.wingspan_m, at.max_range_km, at.cruise_speed_kmh, at.fuel_capacity_kg FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND a.aircraft_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' ) AND a.aircraft_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id FROM maintenance_records WHERE is_aog = 1 ) AND a.aircraft_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id FROM fuel_uplifts WHERE total_cost_usd > 0 )
H10-CAS: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS tax_count FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND (duty_rate_pct + vat_amount_usd / customs_value_usd) * 100 > 20 GROUP BY customs_country
H10-SCH: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND (duty_amount_usd + vat_amount_usd) > 0.2 * customs_value_usd GROUP BY customs_country
H10-BIZ: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND (duty_rate_pct + vat_amount_usd / customs_value_usd) / customs_value_usd > 0.2 GROUP BY customs_country
H10-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT c.declaration_number, c.vat_amount_usd, w.security_level, a.name AS airport_name FROM customs_declarations c JOIN warehouses w ON c.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id JOIN airports a ON w.airport_id = a.airport_id WHERE c.declaration_type = 'import' AND w.security_level = 'high'
